def evallin(L, m, lam_rel, r_list):
    A, S = all_data(L); te = (S<100)&(S%2==1); tr=~te
    pre = f"roberta.encoder.layer.{L}."
    W1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight").astype(np.float64); b1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias")
    W2 = base(pre+"output.dense.weight").astype(np.float64); b2 = base(pre+"output.dense.bias")
    A = A.astype(np.float64); H = gelu(A@W1.T+b1); Z = A + H@W2.T + b2
    den = np.sqrt(((Z[te]-Z[te].mean(0))**2).sum(1)).mean()
    out = {}
    for r in r_list:
        mm = m - r
        sc = H[tr].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0)
        keep = np.sort(np.argsort(-sc)[:mm]); drop = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(3072), keep)
        T = H[:,drop]@W2[:,drop].T
        if r>0:
            # linear features: top-r principal directions of a that best predict residual after H_k -> use reduced-rank: first fit with full a, then SVD
            X = np.c_[H[:,keep], A]
        else: X = H[:,keep]
        mx = X[tr].mean(0); mt = T[tr].mean(0); Xc = X[tr]-mx
        G = Xc.T@Xc; d = np.diag(G).copy()
        lam = lam_rel*np.trace(G[:mm,:mm])/mm
        B = np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.eye(X.shape[1]), Xc.T@(T[tr]-mt))
        if r>0 and r<768:
            # reduced rank on linear block: M = B[mm:] (768x768); keep rank r approx in terms of predictions
            M = B[mm:]; U,s,Vt = np.linalg.svd((A[tr]-A[tr].mean(0))@M, full_matrices=False)
            # project M to top-r output directions
            P = Vt[:r].T@Vt[:r]; Mr = M@P
            # refit H block given Mr fixed
            R = T[tr]-mt - (A[tr]-A[tr].mean(0))@Mr
            Hc = Xc[:,:mm]; Gh = Hc.T@Hc
            Bh = np.linalg.solve(Gh+lam*np.eye(mm), Hc.T@R)
            B = np.r_[Bh, Mr]
        pred = (X[te]-mx)@B + mt
        out[r] = round(np.sqrt(((T[te]-pred)**2).sum(1)).mean()/den,4)
    return out
for L in [1,3]:
    print(L, evallin(L, 1024, 0.1, [0, 32, 64, 128, 768]))
